subject: EnterpriseArchive RFP: SIG / SOC2 evidence intake and timeline
messages:
From: Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@enterprisearchive.com>
To: nikhil_sharma@redwood.ai
Cc: Procurement <procurement@enterprisearchive.com>, Tom Adler <tom.adler@enterprisearchive.com>
Date: 2025-09-28T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: EA RFP — SIG questionnaire + evidence guidance

Hi Nikhil,

Thanks for the quick intro last week. Attached is the SIG questionnaire and an appendix that lists the specific artifacts our assurance team needs for a fast review (EA_RFP_SIG_Appendix_A.pdf). For the intake, can you: 1) confirm a single point-of-contact for each control domain, 2) provide a short mapping (file name -> control id) for artifacts you plan to upload, and 3) confirm whether you can provide a redacted SOC 2 report and an ISO 27001 scope statement?

We'd like initial evidence by Oct 6 to keep to our procurement window; if that's not possible, please propose an alternate cadence. Also indicate any items that will require NDAs or restricted access — procurement will need to know.

Thanks,
Elena Ruiz
Senior Security Architect
EnterpriseArchive

Attachment: EA_RFP_SIG_Appendix_A.pdf (SIG questionnaire + requested artifact list)
From: Nikhil Sharma <nikhil_sharma@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@enterprisearchive.com>
Cc: kimberly_park@redwood.ai, ben_carter@redwood.ai, jasmine_liu@redwood.ai
Date: 2025-09-29T10:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: EA RFP — SIG questionnaire + evidence guidance

Hi Elena — thanks for sending this over and for the clarity in Appendix A. We're ready to run a focused evidence sprint. Quick commitments below and a proposed MAP (mutual action plan).

Control domains and internal owners (single POC each):
- Security controls / architecture: Kimberly Park (kimberly_park@redwood.ai)
- Key management & encryption proofs: Ben Carter (ben_carter@redwood.ai)
- Observability / telemetry evidence: Jasmine Liu (jasmine_liu@redwood.ai)

Proposed intake cadence (compressed):
1) Today (Sep 29): We upload evidence_manifest_template.xlsx and a short mapping CSV that names the artifact and the control it covers.
2) Oct 1–3: Deliver first-pass artifacts (logs, config exports, policy statements) for 50% of SIG controls.
3) Oct 6: Deliver remaining artifacts and a redacted SOC 2 summary (PDF).

Questions / notes:
- We can provide a SOC 2 report redacted to remove customer names; full report delivery will require a standard NDA/attestation.
- ISO 27001 scope: we can provide the scope statement and certificate image if you require it; our managed-private deployments are out of scope and we'll mark those artifacts accordingly.
- Any artifacts that include telemetry samples will be redacted to remove customer identifiers; see attached redaction_guidelines.txt.

I've attached the evidence_manifest_template.xlsx for your intake schema. Please confirm whether EA prefers evidence uploaded to your SFTP or to the Google Drive folder. We can enable time-limited access links.

I'll schedule a 30-minute sync for Oct 2 to walk through any gating items; propose 10:00 PT unless you suggest otherwise.

Best,
Nikhil Sharma
Head of Security Partnerships
Redwood Inference

Attachments: evidence_manifest_template.xlsx; redaction_guidelines.txt
From: Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@enterprisearchive.com>
To: Nikhil Sharma <nikhil_sharma@redwood.ai>
Cc: Procurement <procurement@enterprisearchive.com>, Tom Adler <tom.adler@enterprisearchive.com>
Date: 2025-09-30T08:21:00-07:00
Subject: Re: EA RFP — SIG questionnaire + evidence guidance

Hi Nikhil — this plan works largely for us. A few clarifications:

1) Delivery target: Oct 6 is important for internal reviewers; if you can commit to the Oct 1–3 partial delivery and Oct 6 final bundle, that keeps us on schedule.
2) SOC 2 redaction: our reviewers accept redacted PDF but will want a signed attestation that the redacted version is complete (i.e., nothing material was removed). Can you provide that?
3) ISO artifacts: please include the scope statement and the exact certificate file name in the manifest.
4) Evidence upload: we prefer the Drive folder (link below) and will create a dedicated intake subfolder per vendor. Please request access to the folder and we'll grant it.

Also, procurement asked whether Redwood can accept a standard EA PO (Net 45) and whether the sample contract redlines need a legal contact for back-and-forth. Tom will be the procurement reviewer for terms.

Drive link: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3cEA-Evidence-Upload
DocuSign PO: https://app.docusign.com/EA-PO-2025

Thanks,
Elena

--
